ruleDefinitions.name: Mstsc.EXE Execution With Local RDP File
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential RDP connection via Mstsc using a local ".rdp" file

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\mstsc\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "mstsc\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX("\\\.rdp$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.rdp\\$"))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\lxss\\wslhost\.exe" AND process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Microsoft\\\\WSL\\\\wslg\\\.rdp.*")))
